Good to know

Your Hours Tracker
questions, answered.

Can I enter a shift I forgot to record?

Yes. Add shifts manually and edit previous entries, including their hours, breaks and notes.

Are the earnings figures a payslip?

No. Estimates use your logged hours, rates and overtime settings. They do not include tax or other deductions and should be checked against your employer’s records.

How do I get help with Hours Tracker?

Email info@digitalsprout.org with your device, app version and a description of the issue. You can also visit our support page.
